tasks.short: Evaluate fitness and wellness programme effectiveness

steps.what: Define programme effectiveness questions and comparison criteria
Gather and check programme participation, outcomes and feedback
Calculate specified effectiveness summaries and comparison tables
Evaluate effectiveness, limitations and possible programme changes
Write programme evaluation findings and supporting references

tasks.design: Configure supported programme-record exports in {OPS_SYSTEM}, reproducible summary tables in {SPREADSHEET} and evaluation headings in {DOCS}. The coordinator chooses meaningful measures and interprets effectiveness; calculation and actual evaluation writing are separate steps.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programme records and comparison tables are manually assembled for each evaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports, fixed formulas and linked document structures can reduce repeated handling.
tasks.still_hard: Whether observed changes reflect the programme and matter to participants.
tasks.human_edge: Judgement about comparability, inclusion and practical improvement.
tasks.altitude: More reproducible evidence supporting programme decisions.

evidence.claim: Native record exports and specified summary formulas may reduce repeated programme evaluation handling; no fitness-effectiveness time case is supplied in the digest.

assumptions: Includes the actual written evaluation; a later presentation or send needs its own action if required in practice.

Coordinator produces outcome definitions, period and comparator in s1, and captures programme identifier, attendance, outcome, feedback date, units, source version and missingness definitions in s2. That capture and checking time is counted. Incompatible measures or missing fields stop automated summaries and return to manual comparison.
Use native exports and existing spreadsheet formulas first; no model makes causal claims or individual health decisions.
Already-automated tables offer no new saving. Ordinary author saves remain fully retained within s5 without self-approval.
research_questions: Can summary tables be reproduced from a frozen dataset without losing missingness or changing denominators?

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and validate formula changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R74.75 gross25.25 less3 upkeep gives central22.25. Low retains24/25 dataset work,12/15 calculations and18/20 report writing with non-comparable measures and incomplete identifiers: gross6 less3=3. High retains21/25 dataset work,6/15 calculations and16/20 writing when outcome definitions and templates fit: gross17 less3=14. Measure choice and effectiveness judgement remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop diverse fitness and wellness classes

steps.what: Assess class needs and gaps in fitness offerings
Retrieve current class resources and facility constraints
Design class content and adaptations for varied participants
Write class plans, descriptions and instructor materials

loop.purpose: Express the coordinator's chosen class design clearly
loop.input: selected activities, adaptations and authorised references
loop.output: draft class description and instructor notes
loop.check: Coordinator checks meaning, suitability, constraints and unsupported exercise advice
loop.stop: One revision then manual writing if content or adaptations change
loop.why_not_simpler: Different class formats need varied explanatory language

steps.what: Trial class feasibility and revise plans from observations

tasks.design: Configure class-reference links and plan structures in {DOCS}, using facility information from {OPS_SYSTEM}. A bounded loop writes the coordinator's selected design; deciding activities, adaptations and the diversity of offerings remains human, with a separate feasibility trial.
tasks.previous_blocker: Class references and written instructor materials are assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document structures and constrained drafting can reduce writing repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Designing an inclusive, suitable class mix and adapting it to real participants and facilities.
tasks.human_edge: Practical teaching judgement and knowledge of the community.

ambition.what: Test whether a separately designed accessible format can serve participants missing from the current class mix.

tasks.altitude: More attention to class suitability and gaps in the offering.

reach.task: Adapt learning material for different participants
reach.learn: Test comprehension and accessibility in practice

evidence.claim: Native class-plan structures and source-bound drafting may reduce written preparation; the digest has no fitness-class design timing case.

assumptions: Includes actual class-plan writing and feasibility revision. Scheduling, advertising and delivery require their own actions when undertaken; they are not silently performed by this design.

Coordinator produces needs in s1, captures facility limits, instructor qualifications, class-resource version and source references in s2, chooses content in s3 and writes plans in s4. Capture is counted; missing or incompatible resources are checked manually rather than filled from a model.
Native class-plan layouts and current reference links come first. The loop cannot prescribe new activities, infer participant health status or select adaptations.
Ordinary author saves are retained and ungated. The optional new audience format is outside the saving estimate.
research_questions: Can constrained drafting reduce writing without changing the chosen activities or participant adaptations?

incremental.description: Maintain class layouts and inspect drafting failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R87 gross13 less2 upkeep gives central11. Low retains all15 reference lookup and23/25 writing for a novel class with little compatible material: gross2 less2=0. High retains13/15 lookup and18/25 writing with useful references and reusable instructor language: gross9 less2=7. Needs assessment, content design and feasibility trial remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check equipment condition and the learner's demonstration needs
Locate the current equipment instructions
Demonstrate proper operation of the fitness equipment
Observe learner practice and clarify operation questions
outputs: clarified learning points and follow-up needs

steps.what: Write existing induction and equipment-demonstration notes
inputs: clarified learning points and follow-up needs

tasks.design: Configure current equipment-reference links and existing induction-note fields in {DOCS}. Demonstration and observation of practice remain in person; the actual record is written separately rather than hidden in teaching time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instruction references and repeated induction-note headings require small amounts of handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked instructions and record fields may reduce that supporting work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising the learner's needs and explaining correct equipment operation in person.
tasks.human_edge: Responsive teaching and observation of actual practice.
tasks.altitude: Simplify the supporting record while retaining physical demonstration.

reach.learn: Observe practice rather than assuming a completed demonstration means competence

evidence.claim: Native reference links and induction-note fields may reduce a small amount of clerical work; the physical demonstration is not automated.

assumptions: Scenario includes an existing induction note; validate that record instead of inventing paperwork. The actual demonstration and practice remain fully retained.

Coordinator observes equipment and learner context in s1, captures equipment identifier and instruction version in s2, produces follow-up points in s4 and records date, equipment and relevant learning points in s5. Capture time is counted. Missing instructions or uncertain learning needs are resolved manually.
Native reference and note configuration comes first; no inferred health status, automatic competency flag or machine demonstration.
The ordinary same-system note save stays fully retained within s5 without self-approval.
unknowns: Whether an induction note is written for this episode
Current instruction access and note structure
research_questions: Do linked instructions and existing note fields reduce handling while preserving the actual learning needs?

incremental.description: Maintain equipment links and note fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact equipment, current instructions and demonstration selected for this learner checked immediately before teaching; changed context requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R97 gross3 less1 upkeep gives central2. Low retains all5 reference lookup and9/10 note writing because instructions need full reading: gross1 less1=0. High retains all5 lookup and8/10 notes with an already suitable induction layout: gross2 less1=1. Equipment checking, demonstration and observed practice remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct wellness needs and satisfaction surveys

steps.what: Define needs-assessment purpose, participants and appropriate questions
Write survey form and participation information
outputs: checked survey form and invitation text

steps.what: Send final survey invitation to the chosen participants
inputs: checked survey form and invitation text

steps.what: Collect responses, capture assessment data and check completeness
Assess interest and satisfaction using native response views
Write needs-assessment findings and response limitations

tasks.design: Configure approved form layouts and native response views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, with findings headings in {DOCS}. The coordinator chooses questions, sends the checked invitation through {EMAIL}, collects and checks responses, interprets them and writes the actual assessment record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Question layouts, response handling and assessment records are repeatedly assembled.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form reuse and response views may reduce handling without generating synthetic respondents.
tasks.still_hard: Representative participation, meaningful questions and interpreting silence or dissatisfaction.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding participants and acting responsibly on limited evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less survey administration and clearer evidence for programme needs.

reach.learn: Keep instrument version and missingness visible

evidence.claim: Native survey-form reuse and response views may reduce administrative handling; the digest supplies no wellness-survey time case.

assumptions: Includes questionnaire writing, actual invitation, response capture, assessment and written findings. This is a participant survey, not an automated individual health assessment.

Coordinator produces purpose, question wording and permitted participant list in s1-s2; participants produce their real answers after s3, with respondent time unchanged. Coordinator captures form version, response date, item and response values, missingness and permitted grouping in s4, whose time remains counted. Incompatible or incomplete answers are checked manually; no pre-existing satisfaction code is assumed.
Native form layouts and existing response views come first; their existing runtime is not new saving. No model coding, automatic invitation, reminder or unlisted machine send is proposed.
Ordinary same-system author saves are retained without self-approval. If participants are internal employees, the actual send uses internal rather than external authority.
unknowns: Participant list permissions and survey sensitivity
research_questions: Do native forms and views reduce handling without changing question meaning or hiding missing responses?

already_counted.description: Survey form, response and findings checks

incremental.description: Maintain forms, response fields and findings structures

approvals.approved_version: Exact survey version, invitation wording, access link and participant list; changes require renewed final-version check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R82 gross18 less3 upkeep gives central15. Low retains19/20 form writing,19/20 response handling,19/20 assessment and14/15 findings when questions are novel and response metadata need repair: gross4 less3=1. High retains17/20 form writing,16/20 response handling,17/20 assessment and13/15 findings with compatible question layouts and native response fields: gross12 less3=9. Purpose choice and actual invitation send remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce programme evidence and document assembly while retaining participant understanding and practical fitness judgement.
reach: More suitable and diverse class designs
role.ambitious_version: A coordinator who spends more time improving suitable programmes and less time rebuilding forms, tables and records.
